title: Animation to animation is temporarily in the free tier if you want to try it out
author: Kaninen_Ka9en
selftext:
Animation to animation is temporarily in the free tier if you want to try it out. It will be in the free tier till at least next Sunday :)

[Our website](http://www.pixellab.ai)

comments.author: CakeData
comments.body: What model are you using to generate the images?

replies.author: outerspaceisalie
replies.body: yes im interested in this too, it's surely a finetune... perhaps of flux?

replies.author: SupermarketWinter176
replies.body: mostly controlnet openpose i noticed all animation tools mainly use this the t2i animation use wan i think

comments.author: Shaz_berries
comments.body: I've actually used this a bit! It's really impressive! Usually need to do some touch ups but it gives me a solid starting point, especially as a dev with little pixel art exp

comments.author: Souplesse3
comments.body: Can it do different resolutions? Like 32x32, 64x64?

replies.author: Kaninen_Ka9en
replies.body: Yea, up to 128x128 at the moment. The smaller the canvas the more frames you can do at once :)

replies.author: aneditorinjersey
replies.body: Dang. Sounds cool. Reminds me of the duck tales game.
